paper.title: Viridis Intelligence Bound — ProofLens demonstration packet

claims.title: Energy budget implies an operation bound
claims.statement:
∀ (P T kB D N t : ℝ),
  0 < T →
    0 < kB →
      0 < D →
        N * ProofLens.Examples.landauerCost kB T D ≤ ProofLens.Examples.energyBudget P t →
          N ≤ ProofLens.Examples.energyBudget P t / ProofLens.Examples.landauerCost kB T D

claims.title: Variables carry physical interpretations
claims.statement: P, T, kB, D, N, and t are interpreted as physical or operational quantities through author annotations.
claims.note: These meanings are annotations, not part of the Lean theorem.

claims.title: External deployment claims are outside the theorem
claims.statement: No commercial, empirical, policy, or deployment outcome follows from this formal bound alone.
